revision_summary:
Two quote timestamp issues need fixing: (1) the 'What company is that?' quote in cherry_pick_moments[1] is timestamped 06:26 but actually starts at 06:24 in the transcript — correct the ts. (2) observed_outcome cites 'we'll be here' at 13:08 loosely; confirm exact ts (13:08-13:10) and attribute cleanly to the customer line. Neither is a fabrication, both are minor drift, but fix for precision.

Substantive fixes required: (a) Two schema_reference mismatches must be corrected — cherry_pick_moments[0] cites dq_rules.roof_too_old_no_replacement for a shading/tree concern that has no matching dq_rule in the schema (either flag as a schema gap or drop the citation); cherry_pick_moments[4] cites protocols.time_constraint for a scheduling-around-visitors moment that has nothing to do with call-duration anchoring — recite as analysis_directives.conditional_booking_detection instead. (b) Add the missed moment at 04:19 where the customer gives an uncertain self-reported credit answer ('not sure, but pretty sure') that the rep accepts without follow-up — this is a direct, clean example of the credit_qualifier stated-vs-pulled risk the schema explicitly flags as an open Kenny policy question, and it belongs in cherry_pick_moments. (c) Add or at least note the 05:01 moment where the customer suggests possible prior same-day contact ('Did I talk to you earlier today?') that the rep dismisses without checking lead type/duplicate contact — relevant to the schema's lead_type metadata gap. (d) Soften or caveat the rep_intent claim at 12:12 that the booking pivot reflects a 'scripted booking push' — this is speculative; note the alternative (rep simply didn't return to the shading thread) alongside it. (e) In observed_outcome, mark appointment_channel as inferred rather than stated outright, since the transcript never explicitly confirms phone vs. in-person, only strongly implies in-person via 'come out and see' language.
